 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Kyoji Horiguchi and Asu Almabayev meet on the UFC Fight Night 294 main card at ABHA Arena in Doha, Qatar. Check out this quick breakdown of the matchup from MMA Junkie analyst Dan Tom. 
 Last event's results: 1-3-1
 UFC main cards, 2026: 126-82-2
 Kyoji Horiguchi vs. Asu Almabayev UFC Fight Night 294 preview
 Horiguchi (36-6 MMA, 9-2 UFC) aims to rebound from the first loss of his second UFC stint. After defeating Tagir Ulanbekov and Amir Albazi, Horiguchi lost a key matchup against Manel Kape in June.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Almabayev (24-3 MMA, 7-1 UFC) will look to make it four in a row. His current winning streak includes wins over Jose Ochoa, Alex Perez and Charles Johnson.
 Kyoji Horiguchi vs. Asu Almabayev UFC Fight Night 294 expert pick, prediction
 Filling out the main card is a men's flyweight attraction between ranked fighters, Kyoji Horiguchi and Asu Almabayev.
 I'm happy to see this division being featured more prominently in 2026, and both Horiguchi and Almabayev are fighters deserving of the attention.
 Almabayev has continued to make steady improvements off of his lone setback in the octagon, but I suspect that powerful strikers who can counter grapple still provide problems for the Kazakh fighter.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Horiguchi's defense is not beyond reproach, but the former UFC title challenger has made serious strides in his wrestling since moving shop to American Top Team and brings a wealth of experience into this matchup.
 I expect a tight and tedious affair to score considering the styles and output at play, but I'll pick Horiguchi to edge out a decision win by landing the more meaningful and impactful offense.
 Watch UFC Fight Night 294 with Paramount+ 
 Kyoji Horiguchi vs. Asu Almabayev UFC Fight Night 294 odds
 The oddsmakers and the public favor the Japanese fighter, listing Horiguchi -188 and Almabayev +152 via FanDuel.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Kyoji Horiguchi vs. Asu Almabayev UFC Fight Night 294 start time, how to watch
 Horiguchi and Almabayev are expected to walk to the cage at approximately 12:40 p.m. ET. The fight streams live on Paramount+ .
